# NVRHI shared backend

NVIDIA-RTX/NVRHI, MIT, pinned bf0bbd9b666a7297492beb1999a4ddc0dfded143.
https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/NVRHI
Fetched by cmake/nvrhi.cmake, no modified upstream source or restricted SDK.

Microsoft DirectX-Headers dependency, MIT, pinned d873b344dc540898868697245f100c2a67fe68d9 (v1.717.0-preview).
https://github.com/microsoft/DirectX-Headers

Include both licence texts when distributing the compiled optional backend.
NVRHI creates/submits only our owned command lists. Native game-list work and its existing retirement owners are retained. Runtime option is off by default.
